get.description:
Get a paginated list of goods receipts for a billing account.
This endpoint allows external billing systems (like Cisbox) to fetch goods receipt data.
The billing account must belong to the authenticated user.

**Filters:**
- `startDate` / `endDate`: Filter by delivery date range
- `syncStatus`: Filter by sync status (not_synced, synced, failed)

**Pagination:**
- `page`: Page number (default: 1)
- `limit`: Items per page (default: 25, max: 100)

schema.title: Start date for delivery date range filter (format: Y-m-d).
End date for delivery date range filter (format: Y-m-d).
Page number for pagination (must be greater than or equal to 1).

403.description: Forbidden - No access to this billing account

post.description:
**SAMPLE ENDPOINT for External Billing Systems**

This endpoint shows how external billing systems (like CisBox) should implement
their webhook to receive goods receipt data pushed from FoodNotify.

**Flow:**
1. External system registers their webhook URL with FoodNotify
2. FoodNotify creates/updates a goods receipt (delivery note or accepted order)
3. FoodNotify POSTs the goods receipt data to external system's webhook URL
4. External system receives and validates the data
5. External system stores the goods receipt in their database
6. External system returns success response with their internal ID
7. FoodNotify updates sync status and stores the external ID

**Authentication:**
- External system should validate request signature/token from FoodNotify
- Verify the billing account is authorized

**Response:**
- Return 200 with `externalId` on success
- Return 400 for invalid data
- Return 401/403 for authentication/authorization failures

requestBody.description: Goods receipt data pushed from FoodNotify

200.description: Goods receipt received and processed successfully

externalId.description: ID assigned by external billing system (e.g., CISBOX-12345)

400.description: Invalid request data or JSON payload

403.description: Forbidden - No access to this billing account

get.description:
Paginated list of daily aggregated stock movements (opening / closing /
delta of price and amount) per ERP and concrete product.
Filter by ERP IDs, concrete product IDs,
and a business date range; sort ascending or descending by business date.
Omitting `erp_ids` returns data across all ERPs the master user owns.

200.description: Paginated list of daily stock-change summaries

403.description: User does not have access to one of the requested ERPs.

404.description: One of the requested ERPs was not found.

get.summary: 📈 List stock movements grouped by reason.
get.description:
Paginated list of stock movements aggregated per ERP, business date,
concrete product, and reason. Sum of amount
and price deltas are reported per group. Same filters as the index
endpoint: ERP IDs, concrete product IDs, business date range, order.
Omitting `erp_ids` returns data across all ERPs the master user owns.

200.description: Paginated list of stock movements grouped by reason

403.description: User does not have access to one of the requested ERPs.

404.description: One of the requested ERPs was not found.

get.summary: 🧮 Aggregate stock movements across a flexible set of grouping dimensions.
get.description:
Groups stock movements by any combination of ERP, concrete product, and/or
reason (configurable via `group_by`). Each row carries the grouping keys,
the covered period (from business_date filters), and the aggregated values.
`deltaPrice` is always included; `deltaAmount` is included only when
`concrete_product_id` is part of the grouping (summing amounts across
heterogeneous products would be meaningless). Supports the same base
filters as the other endpoints plus the movements-style `reasons` filter.

200.description: Paginated list of aggregated stock movements

403.description: User does not have access to one of the requested ERPs.

404.description: One of the requested ERPs was not found.

startDate.title: Start date for delivery date range filter (format: Y-m-d).

endDate.title: End date for delivery date range filter (format: Y-m-d).

page.title: Page number for pagination (must be greater than or equal to 1).

GoodsReceiptResource.title: GoodsReceipt
GoodsReceiptResource.description: GOODS_RECEIPT document - used for both delivery notes and accepted orders. The presence of confirmationNumber distinguishes between the two.

number.title: Delivery note number (external delivery note ID).

issueDate.title: Date when the document was issued.

confirmationNumber.title: Order confirmation number (optional, only for accepted orders). Format: K-{orderId}.

erpIds.description: ERP IDs the query was scoped to

concreteProductIds.description: Concrete product IDs the query was scoped to

granularity.description: Time bucket granularity applied (aggregate endpoint only)

group.description: Grouping keys plus the covered period. Contains the fields included in the `group_by` query parameter and a `period` entry as [from, to] (inclusive). For `PERIOD` granularity the period is derived from the business_date_from / business_date_to filters (null elements indicate an unbounded side); otherwise it is the bucket range for the granularity.

values.description: Aggregated values. Price fields (`deltaPrice`, `grossInflowPrice`, `grossOutflowPrice`) are always present. Amount fields (`deltaAmount`, `grossInflowAmount`, `grossOutflowAmount`) and their base-unit counterparts (`deltaAmountBaseUnit`, `grossInflowAmountBaseUnit`, `grossOutflowAmountBaseUnit`) are only present when `concrete_product_id` is in `group_by` (summing amounts across heterogeneous products is meaningless). `grossInflow*` sums only positive changes, `grossOutflow*` sums only negative changes.

SupplierResource.title: GoodsReceiptSupplier
SupplierResource.description: Supplier (shop) identification - requires either vatNumber or GLN

GLN.title: Global Location Number of the supplier.

GoodsReceiptClientResource.title: GoodsReceiptClient
GoodsReceiptClientResource.description: Client identifier in the external billing system

accountNumber.title: Recipient account number in the external billing system (e.g. ClearingCenterID for Cisbox).

LineItemResource.title: GoodsReceiptLineItem
LineItemResource.description: A single line item in a goods receipt document

totalPrice.title: Total price for this line item (gross).

taxRate.title: Tax rate (currently always 0 as prices are gross).

period.description: Period the row covers, as [from, to] (inclusive). For daily granularity both elements equal the business date.

openingPrice.description: Opening price at the start of the business date

deltaPrice.description: Sum of price deltas within the business date

closingPrice.description: Closing price at the end of the business date

openingAmount.description: Opening amount at the start of the business date

deltaAmount.description: Sum of amount deltas within the business date

closingAmount.description: Closing amount at the end of the business date

openingAmountBaseUnit.description: Opening amount expressed in the base unit at the start of the business date

deltaAmountBaseUnit.description: Sum of amount deltas in the base unit within the business date

closingAmountBaseUnit.description: Closing amount expressed in the base unit at the end of the business date

period.description: Period the row covers, as [from, to] (inclusive). For daily granularity both elements equal the business date.

reason.description: Movement reason (food-waste detail → ref_type → raw reason, first non-empty)

totalAmount.description: Total amount moved within the period for this reason

totalAmountBaseUnit.description: Total amount moved expressed in the base unit within the period for this reason

totalPrice.description: Total price moved within the period for this reason
